Field Engineer Job at Mojec International Limited




        
    

        
        Mojec International Limited - MOJEC Power is ranked in the top 3 Nigerian Companies operating in the power sector. Mojec Power is the leading electricity contractor to African Governments on Power Generation, Transmission and Distribution Projects. MOJEC is chiefly known on the continent as a market leader and innovator in metering.

Due to expansion, we are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Field Engineer 

Job Locations: Enugu, Anambra and Imo
Employment Type: Fixed Term

Job Scope 
     

            
    




	Planning & Scheduling Route planning: Create daily/weekly installation schedules for field teams based on customer list, geography, and priority zones.
	Material planning: Ensure correct number of smart meters, CTs, seals, cables, and tools are issued to each installer team.
	Customer notification: Send SMS/calls/appointments to customers about installation date and requirements.
	Oversight Team deployment: Assign installers and supervisors to specific locations and monitor their movement. 
	Quality control: Spot-check installations to ensure compliance with NERC, utility, and manufacturer standards. Check wiring, sealing, and commissioning.
	Safety compliance: Ensure PPE, lock-out/tag-out, and safety procedures are followed on site.
	Customer & Stakeholder Management Customer education: Explain benefits of smart meters, tariff structure, and how to read/operate the meter to customers.
	Issue resolution: Handle complaints during installation - no power, wrong location, tenant/landlord issues.
	Liaison: Coordinate with distribution engineers, customer service, marketing, and community leaders to reduce resistance
	Data & System Management/AMI data entry: Capture meter serial numbers, GPS coordinates, customer details, and photos into the billing system/MDMS after each install.
	Job completion tracking: Update dashboard with % completion, failed installs, and reasons for failure
	Report generation: Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on installations, rejections, and material usage to management.
	Stock control: Track meters issued vs meters installed vs meters returned/defective.
	Seal and asset accountability: Account for all seals, meters, and old analog meters removed.
	Defective handling: Coordinate return and testing of faulty meters.
	Compliance & Administration/MAP compliance: Ensure installations follow Meter Asset Provider and NERC MAP regulations for Nigeria, or local regulator standards. 
	Documentation: Collect signed job cards, customer consent forms, and proof of installation.
	Performance monitoring: Track installer KPIs: installs per day, first-time success rate, customer satisfaction.


Key KPIs for this Role Installation


	Target Achievement – % of monthly target met 
	First-Time Install Success Rate - % without callbacks 
	Data Accuracy - % of meters correctly captured in MDMS 
	Customer Complaints - number per 100 installs 
	Safety Incidents – zero tolerance.


Qualifications & Skills 


	BSc / HND in Electrical Engineering or related fields
	Strong problem solving, technical, math and science skills
	Strong written and verbal communication.
	Experience in crises management  
	Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application and Resume with their current monthly salary in the body to:? [email protected] and copy: [email protected] using the Job Position and preferred ?location as the subject of the mail.

Cashier Job at Givanas Group




        
    

        
        Givanas Group is a dynamic and innovative multi-business organization that operates across industries, providing high-quality products and services to customers in West Africa. Givanas also enhances the quality of life for people worldwide by delivering high-quality products and services that enrich their daily experiences. They aspire to be an indispensable part of consumers’ lives, ensuring that their brands resonate with customers across cultures and geographies.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Cashier 

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Handle daily cash, POS and transfer transactions.
	Reconcile collections and maintain accurate records.
	Support daily finance operations.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree / HND qualification with 1 - 2 years of work experience.


Salary
N150,000 - N180,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected], using Job Position as the subject of the email.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Customer Success Account Management Manager",
  "description": "Microsoft Corporation is an American multinational technology company with headquarters in Redmond, Washington. It develops, manufactures, licenses, supports, and sells computer software, consumer electronics, personal computers, and related services. Its best known software products are the Microsoft Windows line of operating systems, the Microsoft Office suite, and the Internet Explorer and Edge web browsers.&nbsp;

At Microsoft our mission and values are to help people and businesses throughout the world realize their full potential.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Success Account Management Manager

Job number: 200047109
Job Location: Nigeria

Overview


	As a Customer Success Account Management (CSAM) Manager, you lead a team of Customer Success Account Managers responsible for delivering customer outcomes, business growth, and long-term customer success across a complex portfolio of accounts. You create alignment between customer priorities, Microsoft strategies, and execution plans by driving disciplined business management, strengthening executive relationships, and enabling consistent, high-quality customer engagement practices.
	You are accountable for delivering predictable customer and business outcomes by leading executive engagement, driving portfolio performance, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and developing a high-performing organization. Through coaching, inspection, and strategic guidance, you empower your team to navigate complexity, prioritize effectively, and deliver measurable impact across customer health, cloud adoption, and AI transformation initiatives. You serve as a trusted advisor to customers, partners, and Microsoft stakeholders, helping align investments and resources to accelerate customer value realization and business results.
	This opportunity will allow you to deepen organizational leadership capabilities, influence strategy across a broader business scope, and develop future leaders while helping customers realize transformational outcomes through Microsoft technologies and services.


Responsibilities


	Lead a team of Customer Success Account Managers to deliver customer outcomes and business results across a diverse portfolio by strengthening customer health, accelerating cloud adoption, and advancing AI transformation.
	Own portfolio performance by establishing business rhythms, inspecting execution, identifying risks and opportunities, and driving accountability for customer, operational, and business outcomes.
	Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executives, providing strategic guidance, aligning priorities, and helping customers achieve measurable business value through Microsoft investments.
	Influence and coordinate cross-functional teams across Microsoft and partner ecosystems to align resources, remove barriers, and deliver integrated customer success strategies at scale.
	Develop a high-performing organization through coaching, succession planning, talent development, and inclusive leadership practices that strengthen team capability, engagement, and readiness for future opportunities.
	Define and reinforce standards for execution quality across customer success planning, governance, customer engagement, and value realization practices, driving consistency and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
	Champion AI adoption, continuous learning, and operational excellence by modeling effective behaviors, leveraging data-driven insights, and scaling successful practices that improve customer and business outcomes.

Overview


	As a Customer Success Account Management (CSAM) Manager, you lead a team of Customer Success Account Managers responsible for delivering customer outcomes, business growth, and long-term customer success across a complex portfolio of accounts. You create alignment between customer priorities, Microsoft strategies, and execution plans by driving disciplined business management, strengthening executive relationships, and enabling consistent, high-quality customer engagement practices.
	You are accountable for delivering predictable customer and business outcomes by leading executive engagement, driving portfolio performance, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and developing a high-performing organization. Through coaching, inspection, and strategic guidance, you empower your team to navigate complexity, prioritize effectively, and deliver measurable impact across customer health, cloud adoption, and AI transformation initiatives. You serve as a trusted advisor to customers, partners, and Microsoft stakeholders, helping align investments and resources to accelerate customer value realization and business results.
	This opportunity will allow you to deepen organizational leadership capabilities, influence strategy across a broader business scope, and develop future leaders while helping customers realize transformational outcomes through Microsoft technologies and services.


Responsibilities


	Lead a team of Customer Success Account Managers to deliver customer outcomes and business results across a diverse portfolio by strengthening customer health, accelerating cloud adoption, and advancing AI transformation.
	Own portfolio performance by establishing business rhythms, inspecting execution, identifying risks and opportunities, and driving accountability for customer, operational, and business outcomes.
	Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executives, providing strategic guidance, aligning priorities, and helping customers achieve measurable business value through Microsoft investments.
	Influence and coordinate cross-functional teams across Microsoft and partner ecosystems to align resources, remove barriers, and deliver integrated customer success strategies at scale.
	Develop a high-performing organization through coaching, succession planning, talent development, and inclusive leadership practices that strengthen team capability, engagement, and readiness for future opportunities.
	Define and reinforce standards for execution quality across customer success planning, governance, customer engagement, and value realization practices, driving consistency and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
	Champion AI adoption, continuous learning, and operational excellence by modeling effective behaviors, leveraging data-driven insights, and scaling successful practices that improve customer and business outcomes.
